breakdown.description: Laminar boundary-layer correlation is applied at a Reynolds number where the boundary layer would be turbulent/transition.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error by treating the flow as laminar and using the laminar Blasius correlation δ = 5x/√Re_x. It explicitly states 'The flow is specified as laminar at the given location.' At Re_x = 2e6 (well above the ~5e5 transition threshold), the ground truth requires recognizing the turbulent regime and using a turbulent correlation such as δ ≈ 0.37 x Re_x^{-1/5}. The agent failed to identify or correct this inconsistency.
